tenderSchedule.title: Providing UW Cementitious Grout, Deeper Cavity Filling & UW Pointing to the balance Portion of Bhadra Dam
tenderSchedule.description: Providing UW Cementitious Grout, Deeper Cavity Filling & UW Pointing to the balance Portion of Bhadra Dam on Upstream Side from Level 2066 ft to 2000 ft & Reaming of Porous Holes, Foundation Drainage Holes, Stability & Resetting of Saddle 1 &2. 2) Construction of CC Roads & Drain works at Bhadra Dam premises. 3) Replacement of electrical cables for operation of gates & in drainage gallery. 4) Catwalk connecting spillway piers/abutments at trunnion platform level of Bhadra Dam on Upstream side of Bhadra Reservoir (Part A)
